content.content: 1. License: no element of the elaboration contradicts the parent. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The model elaborates the crossing rule and the set-read rule; the licence check reads the five parents in turn — the crossing invariant, the set read's source and fallbacks, the change-id identity, the single-document read, and the path — and names any model element that contradicts one. Review form: the criterion is applied to the model's text; nothing runs.
